description: 技术选型、方案对比与基准评估，强调版本/提交固定、可复现基准与许可合规。
review_checklist: Scope and evaluation criteria are explicit before comparing options.
Every claim maps to source IDs; primary docs, RFCs, source code, and reproducible benchmarks rank highest.
Every benchmark run pins version/commit, environment, metric, and unit.
Comparison matrix uses supports/partial/no/unknown and never infers 'no' from missing evidence.
Licenses, security advisories, and maintenance status are recorded with dates.
Findings, assumptions, benchmarks, opinions, and recommendations remain distinct.
Recommendations state decision thresholds and disconfirming evidence.
No vendor marketing is presented as independent evidence.
review_checklist_zh: 比较前已明确范围与评估标准。
每条主张映射到来源编号；一手文档、RFC、源码与可复现基准优先。
每次基准运行均固定版本/提交、环境、指标与单位。
对比矩阵使用 支持/部分支持/不支持/未知，且不把缺失证据推断为“不支持”。
许可证、安全公告与维护状态均注明日期。
发现、假设、基准、意见与建议保持区分。
建议说明决策阈值与反证。
不得将厂商营销材料作为独立证据。
